title: Routes with city names
statementMd:
For flights 1 to 5 show origin city and destination city. Join `airports` twice.

Expected columns: `id`, `from_city`, `to_city`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Alias the airports table as `o` and `d`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT f.id, o.city AS from_city, d.city AS to_city FROM flights f JOIN airports o ON o.code = f.origin JOIN airports d ON d.code = f.destination WHERE f.id <= 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
